field.accent.d: Highlight colour for buttons and selections.
field.admin_ids.d: People allowed to send links to the bot. The first one becomes Super Admin.
field.admin_ids.h: Ask the person to message your bot – an unauthorised user receives their numeric ID in the reply. One ID per line (or comma-separated).
field.allowed_types.h: The real file content is checked, not just its extension.
field.api_enabled.d: Lets other programs on THIS computer send links to the app.
field.api_enabled.h: Off by default. It only listens on 127.0.0.1 (never on your network) and every request needs the API key shown below.
field.api_port.h: Pick a free port between 1024 and 65535. Changing it restarts the API.
field.auto_publish.d: When off, you preview each file and approve it before it is published.
field.auto_publish.h: Files wait on disk until approved or discarded.
field.auto_resume.d: After a restart or crash, unfinished jobs go back to the queue.
field.auto_resume.h: If off, interrupted jobs are marked failed and cleaned.
field.bale_connect_timeout.d: Seconds to wait while connecting to Bale.
field.bale_connect_timeout.h: Increase on slow or filtered networks.
field.bale_read_timeout.d: Seconds to wait for a Bale reply.
field.bale_read_timeout.h: Uploads use a separate, longer limit.
field.bale_retry_backoff.d: Initial wait; doubles on every retry.
field.bale_retry_count.h: Uploads are retried only when the request cannot have reached the server (no duplicate posts).
field.bandwidth.d: Total download speed cap for all jobs (0 = unlimited).
field.bandwidth.h: Value is in kilobytes per second; applied live.
field.bot_enabled.d: Receive links and commands through the Bale bot.
field.bot_enabled.h: Turn off to stop polling Bale. Downloads started from this app keep working.
field.bot_token.d: The secret key that lets this app control your Bale bot.
field.bot_token.h: Create a bot with Bale's official bot-management bot (@botfather) – see docs.bale.ai. It replies with the token. Keep it secret: it is stored in the OS credential vault and masked in all logs.
field.bot_username.d: The public @name of your bot (filled automatically after a successful connection).
field.bot_username.h: It is shown by BotFather when you create the bot. You normally do not need to type it – use the connection test.
field.channel_categories.d: Route certain types to this channel.
field.channel_categories.h: Leave all unticked to accept every type (the default channel is used when no routing matches).
field.channel_default.d: Used when a job has no explicit destination.
field.channel_default.h: Only one channel can be the default.
field.channel_id.h: Public channel: use its @username. Otherwise the numeric chat id. Add your bot as channel admin with permission to post, then press Test.
field.channel_title.d: A label for your own reference.
field.channel_title.h: Optional. Filled automatically from Bale after a successful test.
field.chunk_size.d: How much data is read per step.
field.chunk_size.h: Leave at the default unless you tune performance.
field.cleanup_interval.d: How often orphaned temp files are searched for.
field.cleanup_interval.h: A sweep also runs at start-up.
field.concurrent.d: How many jobs run at the same time.
field.concurrent.h: 2–3 is a good balance; more uses more bandwidth and disk.
field.convert_images.h: The original is kept until conversion succeeds.
field.db_max_size.d: Size above which you should vacuum or lower retention.
field.db_retention.d: Days to keep finished jobs and logs; older rows are archived then deleted.
field.default_caption.d: Template used when no per-type template exists.
field.default_caption.h: Use {filename} {filesize} {filetype} {date} {time} {source} {duration} {resolution}. Missing values are removed cleanly. Max 1024 characters (Bale limit).
field.delete_after_upload.d: Temporary files are removed after a successful publish.
field.delete_after_upload.h: Always on – a core guarantee of this app.
field.dl_connect_timeout.d: Seconds to wait when connecting to a source.
field.dl_read_timeout.d: Seconds without data before a download attempt fails.
field.dl_retry_backoff.d: Initial wait between retries; doubles each time.
field.dl_retry_count.d: Retries after network errors (resumes where it stopped).
field.download_dir.d: Where files live ONLY until they are published; then they are deleted.
field.download_dir.h: Pick a folder with enough free space. The app only ever deletes inside its own job sub-folders there.
field.duplicate_detection.d: Skips content with the same SHA-256 that was already sent to a channel, and links already completed.
field.duplicate_detection.h: Only a hash and size are remembered – never the file.
field.log_level.d: How detailed the log file is.
field.log_level.h: INFO is recommended; DEBUG is for troubleshooting.
field.log_retention.d: Days to keep rotated log files.
field.make_thumbnails.d: Creates preview images for the approval dialog.
field.make_thumbnails.h: Bale's documented send methods take no custom thumbnails, so they are not uploaded.
field.max_file_size.d: Larger files are refused before and during download.
field.max_file_size.h: Bale bots can upload at most 50 MB per file; higher values only make sense with 'split large files'.
field.min_free_disk.d: The queue pauses automatically below this value.
field.min_free_disk.h: Keeps your system drive from filling up.
field.name_prefix.d: Added in front of the published file name.
field.orphan_age.d: Idle job folders older than this are removed.
field.polling_interval.d: How often the app asks Bale for new messages (the documented API has no long-poll timeout).
field.privacy_mode.d: After a job ends, its URL, file name and details are erased from the history.
field.privacy_mode.h: Only a minimal record (time, type, size, result) remains. Duplicate-link detection by URL no longer works for those jobs.
field.proxy.d: Use only if Bale is not reachable directly.
field.proxy.h: Format: http://host:port or socks5://host:port. Credentials in the URL are masked in logs.
field.rate_limit.d: Protects against spam and accidental floods.
field.rate_limit.h: Lower it if the bot is shared with many people.
field.require_confirmation.d: The bot first shows file info and waits for /confirm.
field.require_confirmation.h: Recommended when many people use the bot. Confirmation uses text commands because the documented Bale API has no button-acknowledge call.
field.scan_av.d: Uses Windows Defender or ClamAV if installed.
field.scan_av.h: If no engine is found the app says so – it never reports a fake 'clean'.
field.segments.d: Parallel connections used for large files when the server supports Range requests.
field.segments.h: The app only uses it if the server really supports it.
field.small_first.d: Automatic priority: smaller files get a higher priority.
field.split_large.d: Alternative for Bale's 50 MB bot upload limit: send 49 MB parts.
field.split_large.h: Receivers must join the parts (Windows: copy /b file.001+file.002 out).
field.update_auto.d: Off by default – no network request is made without your consent.
field.update_feed.d: An https JSON file describing the latest version.
field.use_ytdlp.d: Lets the app handle supported public video/audio pages.
field.use_ytdlp.h: DRM, logins and paywalled content are refused.
field.user_id.d: Bale's numeric ID of the person.
field.user_id.h: Ask the person to message your bot – an unauthorised user receives their ID in the reply.
field.user_quota.d: Total download size per day for this person (0 = global default).
field.user_quota_default.d: Maximum total download size a user may request per day (0 = unlimited).
field.user_quota_default.h: Can be overridden per user in Users & roles.
field.user_role.h: Operator: submit links & control own jobs. Admin: + manage queue/users/settings. Super Admin: everything. Read Only: view status.

wiz.welcome_html:
Welcome to BALE DOWNLOAD HUB

This wizard connects your Bale bot and channel in about five minutes.

  • Downloads files from allowed public links
  • Publishes them to your Bale channel
  • Deletes every temporary file afterwards

You can go back at any step; what you enter is kept even if you close the app. Pick your language below.
